payload.summary: Two contrast failures on live controls: document section-nav subtitle and the shared Show-all chip
payload.detail: axe color-contrast. (a) section-nav.tsx:183-185 'Long sections collapsed' computes 3.13:1 at 10px (fg #5291ca on bg #f2f8fe) in BOTH themes; it is a live control, so the inert-control exemption does not apply. (b) show-all-chip.tsx:39-40 computes 4.23:1 at 13px (fg #1d6fb8 on bg #dde9f4) in LIGHT ONLY, passing in dark. Light theme carries three axe violations to dark's one.
